# Tropisch Tours & Travel

> Nairobi-based tour operator and travel agency crafting Kenya safaris, Kenyan coast and Zanzibar beach holidays, international packages to Malaysia & Singapore and Dubai, and tailor-made journeys. Prices are quoted in USD per person.

- Office: Hazina Towers, 19th Floor, Nairobi, Kenya
- Phone / WhatsApp: +254 703 112 833 / +254 182 857 149
- Email: tropischtours@gmail.com
- Website: https://tropischtours.com/

## Kenya safaris

- [Masai Mara Flying Safari](https://tropischtours.com/tour-masai-mara-flying-safari): 3 days / 2 nights fly-in safari with return flights, Sarova Mara Game Camp, migration game drives, and a Maasai cultural visit, from USD 2,520 per person.
- [Maasai Mara Wilderness Safari](https://tropischtours.com/tour-maasai-mara): 3 days / 2 nights at Mara Intrepids Lodge with game drives and private 4x4 from Nairobi, from USD 2,162 per person.
- [Amboseli Wilderness Safari](https://tropischtours.com/tour-amboseli): 3 days / 2 nights at Ol Tukai Lodge with elephant herds, Kilimanjaro views, and private 4x4 from Nairobi, from USD 1,143 per person.
- [Amboseli · Tsavo West · Taita Hills Safari](https://tropischtours.com/tour-amboseli-tsavo-taita): 5 days / 4 nights with elephants, Kilimanjaro views, Mzima Springs, private 4x4, and an optional North Coast beach extension, from USD 3,178 per person.
- [6-Day Ol Pejeta, Lake Nakuru & Masai Mara Safari](https://tropischtours.com/tour-ol-pejeta-nakuru-masai-mara): 6 days / 5 nights with rhinos, flamingos, Big Five game drives, full-board lodges, and private 4x4, from USD 3,222 per person.
- [Nairobi Wildlife, City & Culture Experience](https://tropischtours.com/tour-nairobi-wildlife-city-culture): 5-day family safari and culture itinerary at Argyle Grand with Nairobi National Park, Giraffe Centre, and Sheldrick elephants, from USD 1,939 per adult.
- [Nairobi National Park Half-Day Game Drive](https://tropischtours.com/tour-nairobi-national-park): Private ~5-hour game drive in Nairobi National Park with morning (6:00 AM) or afternoon (2:00 PM) departures, hotel pickup and drop-off, private safari vehicle, English-speaking driver-guide, park fees, and bottled water. Adults from USD 250–328 depending on group size; children USD 144. Meals, tips, personal expenses, and travel insurance not included.

## Beach holidays

- [Mombasa Beach Escape](https://tropischtours.com/tour-mombasa): 3-day all-inclusive coastal package at Voyager Beach Resort with SGR travel and an Old Town excursion, from USD 799 per person.
- [5-Day Diani Beach Getaway by SGR](https://tropischtours.com/tour-diani): 5 days from Nairobi by SGR with beachfront resorts, Wasini Island, Kisite Marine Park, and a sunset dhow cruise, from USD 2,149 per person.
- [Zanzibar Beach Packages](https://tropischtours.com/tour-zanzibar): 4-day escape or 5-day beach and culture package from Nairobi, including return flights Nairobi–Zanzibar, from USD 1,342 per person.

## International packages

- [Malaysia & Singapore Sensation](https://tropischtours.com/tour-singapore-malaysia): 7 days / 6 nights, 4-star hotels (Concorde Hotel Kuala Lumpur and Orchard Rendezvous Hotel Singapore) with daily breakfast. Kuala Lumpur city tour with KL Tower and Petronas Twin Towers, Genting Highlands cable car and Batu Caves, Putrajaya, train from Kuala Lumpur to Singapore, Singapore city drive, Sentosa Island, and Universal Studios Singapore. USD 1,588 per person, minimum 2 travellers sharing. International flights not included.
- [Dubai Family Beachfront Escape](https://tropischtours.com/tour-dubai): 4 nights at Centara Mirage Beach Resort, a 5-star beachfront island family resort, bed and breakfast, with unlimited water park access, airport transfers, and private Dubai City Tour, Desert Safari with BBQ Dinner, and Marina Dhow Cruise with Dinner. USD 867 per person, double sharing. Travel period 1 November – 5 December 2026. International flights not included.
